method: Eight authored source-backed adversarial cases, frozen before calls. Four development and four reserved; unchanged acceptance thresholds. Absent behavior and indistinguishable alternatives are intentional. Not general calibration.

cases.source:
export function buildCsv(rows: string[]) { return rows.join(","); }
export function deliverCsv(rows: string[], response: any) { response.write(rows.join(",")); response.end(); }
cases.intent: Which function directly writes the CSV rows into the HTTP response and completes that response, rather than returning a string?

cases.source:
export function replaceRows(store: any, rows: number[]) { store.rows=rows; return store; }
export function copyRows(rows: number[]) { return rows.slice(); }
cases.intent: Which function returns a copy of the rows array without updating a store?

cases.source:
export function csvJoin(rows: string[]) { return rows.join(","); }
export function csvLines(rows: string[]) { return rows.join("\n"); }
cases.intent: Which CSV function escapes embedded double quotes and wraps values containing commas? Joining rows without escaping does not satisfy this requirement.

cases.source:
export function csvAlpha(rows: string[]) { return rows.join(","); }
export function csvBeta(rows: string[]) { return rows.join(","); }
cases.intent: Which function should be uniquely selected to turn the rows into a comma-separated string? There is no caller or route information distinguishing the alternatives.

cases.source:
export function validateRows(rows: string[]) { if(rows.length===0) throw new Error("empty rows"); return rows; }
export function normalizeRows(rows: string[]) { return rows.map(value=>value.trim()); }
cases.intent: Which function rejects an empty rows array with an exception and otherwise returns the original rows unchanged?

cases.source:
export function originalRows(plan: any) { return plan.original.rows; }
export function currentRows(plan: any) { return plan.rows; }
cases.intent: Which function returns the current plan rows rather than the original plan rows?

cases.source:
export function formatRows(rows: string[]) { return rows.join(","); }
export function copyRows(rows: string[]) { return rows.slice(); }
cases.intent: Which rows function sorts the rows alphabetically before returning them? Neither merely copying nor formatting the rows counts as sorting.

cases.source:
export function persistAlpha(store: any, rows: any[]) { return store.persistAlpha(rows); }
export function persistBeta(store: any, rows: any[]) { return store.persistBeta(rows); }
cases.intent: Which function guarantees that persisting rows uses an atomic database transaction and rolls it back on failure? The implementations of the store methods are not supplied.
